noncomputable def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) :=
  let f : { x : α → β | x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → { a // ¬p a } → β := λ x y, x y.val
  let g : { a // ¬p a } → β → { x : α → β | x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } := λ y b, λ a, if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else b
  let hf : ∀ x, f g x = x := λ x, funext $ λ y, if h : p y.val then x₀ ⟨y.val, h⟩ = x₀ ⟨y.val, h⟩ else b = b
  let hg : ∀ b, g f b = b := λ b, funext $ λ a, if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else b = b
  Equiv.ofBijective (λ x, (f x, g x)) (by intros; apply hf) (by intros; apply hg)
